newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - May 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - May 9.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Friday:
* A World Trade Organisation panel has ruled the European union's ban on hormone-treated beef is illegal.
* The Republican National Committee returned more than $100,000 in donations from a Hong Kong aviation-services and real estate company.
* New York City Mayor Rudolph Giuliani proposed a $33.5 billion budget, representing a spending increase of between two percent and three percent.
* Christians, who are a minority in Lebanon, are awaiting a visit from the Pope.

* The U.S. House of Representatives voted in favour of a bill that would give states $1.5 billion to fight juvenile crime, if they change their laws to require juveniles accused of violent crimes to be tried in court as adults.
* The tiny Alaskan tribe of Athabaskan Indians is contending in the courts that it has the sovereign right to tax and regulate its land, a move the state is arguing is solely in its own domain.

* The chess match pitting Garry Kasparov against a computer known as Deep Blue is raising questions about whether the computer is actually a thinking machine that possesses intelligence or just a glorified calculator.
* The New York City housing authority backs away from a plan to obtain a waiver from federal regulations, which restrict the rent it charges and its spending of government subsidies.
